// CASE dart_nullish_two_awaits expect=fire
Future<List<R?>> loadWithFallback<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R?> Function(T) op, Future<R> Function(T) fallback) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await op(items[index]) ?? await fallback(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_sum_two_awaits expect=fire
Future<List<int?>> totals(List<String> ids, int width) async {
  final results = List<int?>.filled(ids.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < ids.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = (await paid(ids[index])) + (await owed(ids[index]));
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_ctor_two_awaits expect=fire
Future<List<Profile?>> loadProfiles(List<String> ids, int width) async {
  final results = List<Profile?>.filled(ids.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < ids.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = Profile(await loadUser(ids[index]), await loadOrders(ids[index]));
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_canonical_control expect=pass
Future<List<R?>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}
